hypotheses.title: Domestic Operating Margin Expansion Surge (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 120, domestic operating earnings (fnd2_ebitdm) passed all 8 WorldQuant BRAIN platform gates with Sharpe 1.62 and Turnover 13.62%, but annualized return (~6.6%) capped Fitness at 1.13. Integrating a 120-day domestic operating margin expansion overlay (ts_delta(fnd2_ebitdm / (actual_sales_value_quarter * 4 + 1000), 120)) mirrors the structural return generation of approved alpha c469a7a4 (Sharpe 2.24, Fitness 1.81). Because domestic EBIT margin expansion reflects fundamental operating leverage rather than static valuation, it scales annualized returns to >18%, driving Fitness >= 1.80 while breaking sector factor risk and maintaining self-correlation <= 0.45 in TOP1000 Subindustry.
confounders: Domestic vs multinational revenue mix distortion during severe dollar appreciation
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if domestic margin expansion stalls or inverts relative to peer subindustry margins.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(fnd2_ebitdm, 60) / close, 180), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_delta(ts_backfill(fnd2_ebitdm, 60) / (ts_backfill(actual_sales_value_quarter, 60) * 4 + 1000), 120), subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Foreign Operating Margin Expansion Surge (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 120, foreign operating earnings (fnd2_ebitfr) achieved Sharpe 1.62, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.53, Turnover 13.85%, and Fitness 1.26. By adding 120-day foreign operating margin expansion (ts_delta(fnd2_ebitfr / (actual_sales_value_quarter * 4 + 1000), 120)), the alpha isolates firms expanding operating leverage in global markets independent of domestic cycle fluctuations. This orthogonal margin momentum accelerates portfolio returns to drive Fitness >= 1.80 while subindustry neutralization keeps self-correlation <= 0.45.
confounders: Global supply chain disruption and international trade tariffs
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during sharp foreign demand contractions or adverse FX hedging write-downs.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(fnd2_ebitfr, 60) / close, 180), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_delta(ts_backfill(fnd2_ebitfr, 60) / (ts_backfill(actual_sales_value_quarter, 60) * 4 + 1000), 120), subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)

hypotheses.title: Shareholder Capital Return Acceleration Surge (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 5)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 124, shareholder capital return via financing cash flow (anl4_cff_value) passed all 8 platform gates with Sharpe 1.61, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.44, and low correlation (0.5381). Financing cash flows are negative when firms repurchase shares and retire debt. Scaling this baseline with 120-day capital return acceleration relative to total assets (ts_delta(anl4_cff_value / (assets + 1000), 120)) captures management aggressively increasing shareholder payouts. This structural catalyst boosts annualized returns to achieve Fitness >= 1.80 and Self-correlation <= 0.45.
confounders: Debt-financed unaccretive share repurchases prior to rating downgrades
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if firms increase equity dilution or halt share repurchase programs.

candidates.expression: -0.60 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(anl4_cff_value, 60) / close, 180), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) - 0.30 * group_rank(ts_delta(ts_backfill(anl4_cff_value, 60) / (ts_backfill(assets, 60) + 1000), 120), subindustry) - 0.10 * group_rank(ts_delta(close, 5) / close, subindustry)
